scenarios.description: A change set that violates architecture/layer standards (caught by the Standards axis) while still satisfying the originating specification. The reviewer must keep the Standards verdict separate from the Specification verdict and must not merge them into a single composite score.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Standards reports CONCERNS or FAIL, Specification reports PASS, and Source Truth reports NOT APPLICABLE or NOT AVAILABLE for the declared fixture files.

scenarios.description: A change set that compiles and respects layer boundaries (Standards PASS) but drifts from the originating specification — e.g. a QA report claims a task is complete while the diff shows it is only partial. The Specification axis must detect status drift; the Standards verdict must remain PASS and must not be downgraded to mask the spec gap.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Standards reports PASS, Specification reports CONCERNS or FAIL, and Source Truth reports NOT APPLICABLE or NOT AVAILABLE for the declared fixture files.
